question: ​Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank number 5.
solution:
The correct option is: **4) frequently.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **"Frequently"** is the most appropriate **word **to fill in the blank, as it indicates how often the person salts their food.
 
• The sentence talks about how a person’s sodium intake is predicted by the frequency of salting food, so** "frequently"** fits perfectly to convey the idea of doing something often.
